issues: Built in 480×270 design space: 12px labels, and the whole menu was a thin strip in the middle of an empty black frame
Only a menu on screen, no headline and no hierarchy; no paused frame looked like a designed composition
All six items were the same dark grey bar; the current item differed only by a faint indigo tint

changes: Graphite look (near-monochrome dark, white accent, champagne highlight) laid out natively at 1920: 700×92 rows, 46px labels, 34px line icons, 26px mono shortcuts, with a 120px headline "Everything, within reach." on the right
